claims.statement: Theogony records every data mutation in an immutable audit log composed of edit actions and structured operations that preserve timestamps, provenance, and reversion pointers.
Selective revert performs pre-flight conflict analysis to detect dependent downstream modifications and supports resolution via Refuse, Cascade, or Reassign strategies.
Cascade resolution automatically sorts and recursively reverts blocking downstream actions in reverse chronological order (newest first).
Reassign resolution updates dependent foreign keys or field references to alternative target records, enabling safe reverts without losing downstream work.
